newsitem.title: MEXICO: Sidek sees restructuring plan by Nov.
newsitem.headline: Sidek sees restructuring plan by Nov.

text.p: Steel holding company Grupo Sidek's financial restructuring program will be finalized by November, the company's chief executive told Reuters on Monday.
"The plan will be finalized by November and will include them all," said CEO Luis Rebollar, referring to all domestic and foreign banks with which Sidek has loans outstanding.
Domestic banks agreed to extend the period of Sidek's "stand-still", whereby it had frozen debt payments while it finalized its restructuring plan, until November 29.
"We agreed with domestic banks to extend interest and principal payments until November (29), without including foreign banks," Rebollar said.
The company had originally said that the restructuring program would be finalized by June 30.
Grupo Sidek's debts total some $2.1 billion.
-- Maria Luisa Aguilar, Mexico City newsroom +525 728-9553
